# North Star AI work items

## Create a User Story

- Use a short, business-focused title and describe the business need, not the implementation.
- Add relevant tags (for example, `PowerPlatform`, `Dataverse`, or `Dynamics365`)
- Write acceptance criteria in Given / When / Then format.
- Find and link the most relevant existing Feature.
- Present the proposed item and wait for confirmation before creating it.

## Update linked work

- Draft a concise list covering ✅ completed work, 🔍 verification, and ⏳ remaining work or 🚧 blockers.
- Present the proposed update and any status or assignment changes; wait for confirmation before applying them.
- Keep the item Active while work remains; never mark partial work complete.
